review.why: Writes or rewrites page copy after diagnosing the input, with a claims-need-evidence rule and a list of AI writing tells to avoid.
review.summary: Diagnoses whether the input is a blank brief, a draft with a real voice or a point edit, and changes only what that calls for. Drafts unit by unit (headline, subhead, CTA, sections), runs each line through three tests (picturable, provable, not copyable by a competitor), and declines unsupported claims while naming the evidence that would unlock them.
strengths: Leave-it-alone test: changes with no reason are reverted
Missing proof is flagged as a need, never invented
Matches the user's own vocabulary and writing sample
cautions: Page copy only: emails, ads and line edits are left to other skills
Many steps assume a product-marketing context file exists
Three reference files (frameworks, AI tells, transitions) are not read here
